title: Nemotron 3 Ultra Free
notes: The largest open MoE on the free tier at 550B-A55B. It reasons but publishes no selectable effort level, so no variant is ever written for it. Measured at 4.7s, though a cold first request took 34s. Text only. NVIDIA trial terms: sessions are logged, so it is not the lane for private code.
